### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a critical bug where the `sr` pointer was being freed before it was used, leading to potential dereferencing of a freed memory location. By moving the `softreq_destroy(sr);` call to after the callback execution, the patch ensures that the memory referenced by `sr` remains valid during the callback invocation, thus fixing the use-after-free issue. This change maintains the intended functionality while enhancing the safety of the code.

You will be given the root cause of a bug, the commit message and the corresponding patch.
        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug is caused by freeing the `sr` pointer with the `softreq_destroy(sr);` function before it is used in the callback function. This leads to a use-after-free condition, where the code attempts to access memory that has already been deallocated, potentially resulting in undefined behavior or crashes.
        
        Commit message:
        crypto: cavium/nitrox - Use after free in
 process_response_list()

We free "sr" and then dereference it on the next line.

Fixes: c9613335bf4f ("crypto: cavium/nitrox - Added AEAD cipher support")
Signed-off-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/drivers/crypto/cavium/nitrox/nitrox_reqmgr.c b/drivers/crypto/cavium/nitrox/nitrox_reqmgr.c
index e34e4df8fd24..fe070d75c842 100644
--- a/drivers/crypto/cavium/nitrox/nitrox_reqmgr.c
+++ b/drivers/crypto/cavium/nitrox/nitrox_reqmgr.c
@@ -567,10 +567,10 @@ static void process_response_list(struct nitrox_cmdq *cmdq)
 
 		/* ORH error code */
 		err = READ_ONCE(*sr->resp.orh) & 0xff;
-		softreq_destroy(sr);
 
 		if (sr->callback)
 			sr->callback(sr->cb_arg, err);
+		softreq_destroy(sr);
 
 		req_completed++;
 	}
--
